verse.text: As iron sharpens iron, so a friend sharpens a friend.

video.title: As Iron Sharpens Iron | Proverbs 27:17 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: A dad isn't meant to raise his family in isolation — he needs other men who'll tell him the truth, pray with him, and call out his blind spots. If you don't have a friend like that right now, that's worth fixing this week, not someday. And don't forget you're also called to be that kind of iron for someone else's life.
